content.short: Banxa is a financial technology platform offering global Web3 on- and off-ramp services.
content.description: Banxa is a financial technology platform that provides Web3 on- and off-ramp services. It is not a bank or authorised deposit taking institution. Banxa enables global off-ramping of stablecoins through its network of local bank transfers, resulting in higher conversion rates than card-only solutions. The platform is designed to support fiat-to-crypto and crypto-to-fiat movements via its local-transfer network, while remaining outside the traditional banking framework.
